_about: Configurable document types for the drafting engine. 'library_refs' are statutory provisions the engine looks up in the local bare-act library at run time and shows with their page link; nothing here states what a provision says. 'required' facts are asked for when missing instead of being invented.

types.label: Plaint (civil suit)
structure: Place, date, advocate and party signature blocks
required: Date(s) on which the cause of action arose
Valuation of the suit for jurisdiction and court fees
library_refs: Particulars to be contained in a plaint
types.template_match: plaint recovery of money Order VII

types.label: Written statement
required: Which plaint paragraphs are admitted / denied

types.label: Petition (general)
structure: Synopsis / list of dates (if required by the forum)

types.label: Application (interlocutory / miscellaneous)
structure: Court heading and main case number
Title of the application with the provision invoked
required: Provision under which the application is made

types.label: Regular bail application
required: FIR number, police station, date and sections
Date of arrest and custody details
library_refs: When bail may be taken in case of non-bailable offence (Magistrate)
Special powers of High Court or Court of Session regarding bail

types.label: Anticipatory bail application
structure: Apprehension of arrest and FIR details
required: Basis of the apprehension of arrest
library_refs: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest

types.label: Affidavit
required: Deponent's name, age, occupation and address
library_refs: Matters to which affidavits shall be confined

types.label: Consumer complaint
required: Value of goods/services paid as consideration
library_refs: Manner in which complaint shall be made (District Commission)

types.label: Legal notice (general)
structure: Time to comply (only as supplied or as stated in the applicable provision)
types.template_match: legal notice recovery breach of contract

types.label: Demand notice — cheque dishonour (Section 138 NI Act)
structure: Demand for payment within the period stated in the provision
required: Cheque number, date, amount and drawee bank
Date of the bank's return memo and date you received it
Nature of the debt or liability
library_refs: Dishonour of cheque — the proviso sets the notice and payment periods
formalities: Proviso (b) and (c) to Section 138 set the time to send the notice and the period for payment — check them in the provision text shown here.
Keep proof of dispatch and delivery.

types.label: Notice to Government / public officer (Section 80 CPC)
structure: Recipient (authority as specified in the provision)
Name, description and residence of the plaintiff
required: Government / public officer to be served
library_refs: Notice — states the period and particulars required before suing
formalities: Section 80 CPC prescribes to whom the notice must be delivered, its contents and the waiting period before a suit — follow the provision text shown here.
